purpose: Audited upstream references for Terminal Kit required profiles, editor baseline, and optional host-compatible build tools.

headless.authentication: User-managed and may remain pending after install.

workstation.authentication: User-managed and may remain pending after install.
workstation.platform_gaps: Ghostty has no native Windows app and this installer has limited native Linux package support; WSL Nerd Font installation targets the Windows host explicitly.

upstreams.name: omarchy
upstreams.decision: Adapt portable terminal behavior only; omit Omarchy desktop runtime, machine provisioning and agent skills.

upstreams.name: omarchy-nvim-package
upstreams.license_metadata: MIT (PKGBUILD); bundled Starter and plugin files carry their own notices, including Apache-2.0
upstreams.decision: Separate Omarchy-maintained package recipe. Not pinned by Omarchy v4.0.4. The June 2026 recipe commit is pkgver 2026.6.17 and is not the source for this August artifact. Use the verified August artifact and lock as config/plugin provenance; Terminal Kit adapts selected files and pins its own plugin restore. Do not copy the full generated cache or overwrite existing user configuration.

build_input.name: LazyVim Starter
build_input.note: Recipe hashes the moving main archive; this checksum identifies the inspected archive but does not make the recipe commit-pinned.

upstreams.name: neovim
upstreams.decision: Required in both headless and workstation profiles; terminal-kit pins the official release asset. The v0.12.4 value elsewhere is the Omarchy package's recorded build environment, not this runtime pin.

upstreams.name: tree-sitter-cli

source_build.isolation: mise Rust, Cargo home, Rustup home and Cargo target remain under Terminal Kit managed runtime storage; no core system library updates.
source_build.license_handling: MIT and Apache license files are copied from source beside the installed binary; no upstream source is vendored.

upstreams.decision: Use verified official binary when runtime-compatible. On older glibc or when binary install fails, the explicitly selected treesitter-build module compiles pinned source; it does not silently trigger expensive source compilation.

upstreams.name: LazyVim
upstreams.decision: Reference only. The package uses LazyVim Starter and package-owned changes; do not claim the package is an unmodified LazyVim release. The portable lock adds pinned SchemaStore.nvim and venv-selector.nvim commits; all original baseline plugin commits are unchanged.

upstreams.name: SchemaStore.nvim
upstreams.decision: Explicit portable addition to the Omarchy-derived LazyVim lock; original baseline plugin commits remain unchanged.

upstreams.name: venv-selector.nvim
upstreams.decision: Explicit portable addition to the Omarchy-derived LazyVim lock; original baseline plugin commits remain unchanged.

upstreams.name: tmux
upstreams.decision: Include; configuration adapted from the inspected Omarchy defaults.

upstreams.name: ghostty
upstreams.decision: Workstation default. Install through supported OS-native package sources; unsupported distro/Windows GUI cases are reported, with no community repository added automatically. Headless omits it.

upstreams.name: fzf
upstreams.decision: Include; shell integration is conditional.

upstreams.name: ripgrep
upstreams.decision: Include via distribution package; release commit not captured in this audit's fetched metadata. Resolve to a package checksum or source commit before vendoring.

upstreams.name: zoxide
upstreams.decision: Include; shell initialization is conditional.

upstreams.name: eza
upstreams.decision: Include with plain ls fallback.

upstreams.name: starship
upstreams.decision: Include/adapt; shell-specific initialization.

upstreams.name: mise
upstreams.decision: Include; use explicit project versions and normal configuration trust behavior.

upstreams.name: homebrew-installer
upstreams.decision: When macOS has no Homebrew, the stock Bash-compatible helper fetches this official installer and verifies the exact SHA-256 before execution. The official installer may need Command Line Tools, OS authorization, or interactive terminal access; unattended setup can stop for a human prerequisite.

upstreams.name: uv
upstreams.decision: Optional Python tooling.

upstreams.name: lazygit
upstreams.decision: Required in headless and workstation profiles; Git is required.

upstreams.name: lazydocker
upstreams.decision: Required client in both profiles. Docker Engine/service remains a separate user opt-in; this client install does not provision or start a daemon.

upstreams.name: nerd-fonts
upstreams.decision: Workstation default. Download the pinned official release and preserve its LICENSE/notices. WSL must install the font in the Windows host explicitly. Headless omits it.

upstreams.name: opencode
upstreams.decision: Required client in both profiles; installation does not authenticate. No Omarchy policy, skills or launch flags are copied.

shell_selection.behavior: Pinned OpenCode resolves the shell from process.env.SHELL; Terminal Kit exports its detected Bash path for interactive shells.

upstreams.name: pi-coding-agent
upstreams.decision: Required client in both profiles; pinned mise-managed Node/npm satisfies package engine. Installation does not authenticate.

upstreams.name: hermes-agent
upstreams.decision: Required client in both profiles; use the pinned official staged installer with the recorded supported Python range. Setup/authentication remains the user's action; optional browser and computer-use tooling are excluded.

upstreams.name: ripgrep
inspection: official release metadata and macOS archive members
upstreams.decision: Use compatible native packages; verified upstream binaries avoid Intel Homebrew Rust source builds.

upstreams.name: fd
inspection: official release metadata and macOS archive members
upstreams.decision: Use compatible native packages; verified upstream binaries avoid Intel Homebrew Rust source builds.

upstreams.name: bat
inspection: official release metadata and macOS archive members
upstreams.decision: Use compatible native packages; verified upstream binaries avoid Intel Homebrew Rust source builds.
